scope: Second host-session pilot, first run of the launcher's `minimum` module set (CP-0, CP-1, CP-1A, CP-2, CP-5): Caesars Entertainment, Inc., credit snapshot as of 2026-10-02 with an explicit information cutoff of 2026-10-02. Sources are the retained public filings in cases/czr-2026q2-earnings-update/documents (FY2025 10-K, Q2 2026 10-Q, Q2 2026 earnings release; text conversions). The answering host was this Claude Code session. Not independent review, not provider proof, not current underwriting.
why_this_issuer: Caesars has both high-yield bonds and leveraged term loans, so it is the kind of issuer the HY and loan ETF corpus targets. Its filings were already retained offline, while this environment's network policy blocks SEC EDGAR.

execution.rejection: CP-1A attempt 1 quoted source text containing pipe characters inside a table cell; the report adapter refused the split row and CP-OS issued attempt 2 with that feedback. Attempt 1 is retained.

result.sections_populated: 6 of 6 selected credit-snapshot sections; the other 6 sections need modules outside the minimum set
result.cp5_grade: qa_status Passed; Confidence Score 47, band Low, from the method's confidence_score.py; committee status Requires More Work
result.credit_view: Lease financing obligations (13,157) exceed debt (11,807); lease-inclusive leverage 5.30x to 6.95x against 3.29x debt-only; Adjusted EBITDA covers total net interest 1.57x; liquidity 2,928; the pending Fertitta take-private has no supplied financing, which caps CP-2 confidence at Medium.

checks.answer_keys: 23 of 24 expected.json values found in a handoff row carrying the key line's label. Absent: total debt book value at December 31, 2025 (11,792); CP-1 carries the face value 11,905 for that date instead.
checks.metrics: 9 CP-1 metric cells recomputed with Fraction from the source lines CP-1 cites; all equal.
checks.pipeline: verify_delivery passes; every module cites each upstream handoff hash; completion records host-session for all modules; a relaunch writes nothing.
checks.adversarial: A changed six-month revenue drops the key count to 22 of 24; a 5.31x ratio is refused.
checks.cp5_trace: CP-5 checked 59 quotations against their cited lines (none misquoted, 7 imprecise locators) and 15 metrics plus 24 tie-outs (all equal). Its 4 MINOR findings are locator precision and rounded restatements; none changes a conclusion.

limits: One issuer and one date; text conversions, not the filed HTML.
CP-5 is a self-review by the same host; the TDG pilot showed that self-review misses omissions.
The answer keys were written for a CP-1B earnings-update case, so they test reported values, not the credit synthesis.
No document after July 28, 2026 was available, so merger status at the as-of date is unknown.
